tool.name: nf-core/stableexpression
tool.description: This pipeline is dedicated to finding the most stable genes across count datasets
tool.command:
## ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ## Building new samplesheet with renamed files ## ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#if $input_output_options.datasets.provide_datasets == "true":
#set $count_filenames = '' #for $count_dataset in $input_output_options.datasets.count_datasets #set $count_filenames += ' ' + str($count_dataset.name) #end for
#set $design_filenames = '' #for $experimental_design in $input_output_options.datasets.experimental_designs #set $design_filenames += ' ' + str($experimental_design.name) #end for
python '${__tool_directory__}/rebuild_samplesheet.py' --in $input_output_options.datasets.samplesheet --out renamed_samplesheet.csv --count-files $input_output_options.datasets.count_datasets --count-filenames $count_filenames --design-files $input_output_options.datasets.experimental_designs --design-filenames $design_filenames
#else: echo "No user dataset provided"
#end if
## ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ## Running pipeline ## ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
&& nextflow drop -f OlivierCoen/stableexpression || echo "Could not drop OlivierCoen/stableexpression" && nextflow run OlivierCoen/stableexpression -r dev -latest -profile micromamba -ansi-log false --outdir ./results --species "$input_output_options.species"
#if $input_output_options.datasets.provide_datasets == "true": --datasets renamed_samplesheet.csv #end if #if $input_output_options.keywords --keywords "$input_output_options.keywords" #end if #if $input_output_options.platform --platform "$input_output_options.platform" #end if #if $input_output_options.accessions_only --accessions_only $input_output_options.accessions_only #end if #if $input_output_options.download_only --download_only $input_output_options.download_only #end if #if $expression_atlas_options.skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions --skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions $expression_atlas_options.skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions #end if #if $expression_atlas_options.eatlas_accessions --eatlas_accessions "$expression_atlas_options.eatlas_accessions" #end if #if $expression_atlas_options.eatlas_accessions_file --eatlas_accessions_file "$expression_atlas_options.eatlas_accessions_file" #end if #if $expression_atlas_options.exclude_eatlas_accessions --exclude_eatlas_accessions "$expression_atlas_options.exclude_eatlas_accessions" #end if #if $expression_atlas_options.exclude_eatlas_accessions_file --exclude_eatlas_accessions_file "$expression_atlas_options.exclude_eatlas_accessions_file" #end if #if $geo_dataset_options.skip_fetch_geo_accessions --skip_fetch_geo_accessions $geo_dataset_options.skip_fetch_geo_accessions #end if #if $geo_dataset_options.geo_accessions --geo_accessions "$geo_dataset_options.geo_accessions" #end if #if $geo_dataset_options.geo_accessions_file --geo_accessions_file "$geo_dataset_options.geo_accessions_file" #end if #if $geo_dataset_options.exclude_geo_accessions --exclude_geo_accessions "$geo_dataset_options.exclude_geo_accessions" #end if #if $geo_dataset_options.exclude_geo_accessions_file --exclude_geo_accessions_file "$geo_dataset_options.exclude_geo_accessions_file" #end if #if $idmapping_options.skip_id_mapping --skip_id_mapping $idmapping_options.skip_id_mapping #end if #if $idmapping_options.gene_id_mapping_file --gene_id_mapping_file "$idmapping_options.gene_id_mapping_file" #end if #if $idmapping_options.gene_metadata --gene_metadata "$idmapping_options.gene_metadata" #end if --normalisation_method "$statistical_options.normalisation_method" #if $statistical_options.quantile_norm_target_distrib --quantile_norm_target_distrib "$statistical_options.quantile_norm_target_distrib" #end if --ks_pvalue_threshold $statistical_options.ks_pvalue_threshold #if $statistical_options.min_expr_threshold --min_expr_threshold $statistical_options.min_expr_threshold #end if #if $stability_scoring_options.candidate_selection_descriptor --candidate_selection_descriptor "$stability_scoring_options.candidate_selection_descriptor" #end if #if $stability_scoring_options.run_genorm --run_genorm $stability_scoring_options.run_genorm #end if #if $stability_scoring_options.stability_score_weights --stability_score_weights "$stability_scoring_options.stability_score_weights" #end if --nb_top_gene_candidates $stability_scoring_options.nb_top_gene_candidates
&& zip -r results.zip results

section.name: input_output_options
section.title: Input/output options
section.help: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

param.name: species
param.label: Species name
param.help: Genus and species may be separated by ` ` or `_`. Example: `--species 'Arabidopsis thaliana'` or `--species 'homo_sapiens'`

param.name: samplesheet
param.label: Samplesheet
param.help: Path to CSV file containing information about the input count samplesheet and their related experimental design. The dataset file should be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/stableexpression/usage#samplesheet-input) for more information. Before running the pipeline, and for each user count dataset, you will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment. Use this parameter to specify its location. Combine with --skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions if you only want to analyse your own count samplesheet.

param.name: count_datasets
param.label: Count datasets
param.help: User count datasets in CSV format

param.name: experimental_designs
param.label: Experimental designs
param.help: Experimental designs relative to the provided count datasets

param.name: keywords
param.label: Keywords used for selecting specific Expression Atlas / GEO accessions
param.help: Keywords (separated by commas) to use when retrieving specific experiments from Expression Atlas and / or GEO datasets. The pipeline will select all Expression Atlas experiments / GEO datasets that contain the provided keywords in their description of in one of the condition names. Example: `--keywords 'stress,flowering'`. This parameter is unused if both --skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions and --skip_fetch_geo_accessions are set.

param.name: platform
param.label: Only download from this platform
param.help: By default, data from all platform are downloaded. If this parameter is specified, a filter is applied to get data from only one specific type of platform. This filter is only used while fetching appropriate Expression atlas / GEO accessions. It will not filter accessions provided directly by the user.

param.name: accessions_only
param.label: Only get accessions from Expression Atlas / GEO and exit.
param.help: Use this option if you only want to get Expression Atlas accessions and skip the rest of the pipeline.

param.name: download_only
param.label: Only get accessions from Expression Atlas / GEO and download the selected datasets.
param.help: Use this option if you only want to get Expression Atlas / GEO accessions, download the selected data, and skip the rest of the pipeline.

section.name: expression_atlas_options
section.title: Expression Atlas options
section.help: Options for fetching experiment data from Expression Atlas.

param.name: skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions
param.label: Skip fetching Expression Atlas accessions
param.help: Expression Atlas accessions are automatically fetched by default. Set this parameter to skip this step.

param.name: eatlas_accessions
param.label: Expression Atlas accession(s) to include
param.help: Provide directly in command line Expression Atlas accession(s) (separated by commas) that you want to download. Example: `--eatlas_accessions E-MTAB-552,E-GEOD-61690`. Combine with --skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions if you want only these accessions to be used.

param.name: eatlas_accessions_file
param.label: File containing Expression Atlas accession(s) to download
param.help: File containing Expression Atlas accession(s) that you want to download. One accession per line. Example: `--eatlas_accessions_file included_accessions.txt`. Combine with --skip_fetch_eatlas_accessions if you want only these accessions to be used.

param.name: exclude_eatlas_accessions
param.label: Expression Atlas accession(s) to exclude
param.help: Provide directly in command line Expression Atlas accessions (separated by commas) that you want to exclude. Example: `--exclude_eatlas_accessions E-MTAB-552,E-GEOD-61690`

param.name: exclude_eatlas_accessions_file
param.label: File containing Expression Atlas accession(s) to exclude
param.help: File containing Expression Atlas accession(s) that you want to exclude. One accession per line. Example: `--exclude_eatlas_accessions_file excluded_accessions.txt`.

section.name: geo_dataset_options
section.title: GEO dataset options
section.help: Options for fetching datasets from NCBI GEO.

param.name: skip_fetch_geo_accessions
param.label: Skip fetching GEO accessions
param.help: GEO accessions are automatically fetched by default. Set this parameter to skip this step.

param.name: geo_accessions
param.label: GEO accession(s) to include
param.help: Provide directly in command line GEO series accession(s) (separated by commas) that you want to download. Example: `--geo_accessions GSE8165,GSE8161`. Combine with --skip_fetch_geo_accessions if you want only these accessions to be used.

param.name: geo_accessions_file
param.label: File containing GEO accession(s) to download
param.help: File containing GEO series accession(s) that you want to download. One accession per line. Example: `--geo_accessions_file included_accessions.txt`. Combine with --skip_fetch_geo_accessions if you want only these accessions to be used.

param.name: exclude_geo_accessions
param.label: GEO accession(s) to exclude
param.help: Provide directly in command line GEO series accessions (separated by commas) that you want to exclude. Example: `--exclude_geo_accessions GSE8165,GSE8161`

param.name: exclude_geo_accessions_file
param.label: File containing GEO accession(s) to exclude
param.help: File containing GEO series accession(s) that you want to exclude. One accession per line. Example: `--exclude_geo_accessions_file excluded_accessions.txt`.

param.name: gene_id_mapping_file
param.label: Custom gene id mapping file
param.help: Path to comma-separated file containing custom gene id mappings. Each row represents a mapping from the original gene ID in your count datasets to the ensembl ID in g:Profiler. The mapping file should be a comma-separated file with 2 columns (original_gene_id and gene_id) and a header row.

param.name: gene_metadata
param.label: Custom gene metadata file
param.help: Path to comma-separated file containing custom gene metadata information. Each row represents a gene and links its ensembl gene ID to its name and description. The metadata file should be a comma-separated file with 3 columns (gene_id, name and description) and a header row.

section.name: statistical_options
section.title: Statistics options
section.help: Statistical options for normalisation and calculation of gene expression variation.

param.name: normalisation_method
param.label: Tool to use for normalisation
param.help: Raw RNAseq data must be normalised before further processing. You can select the package used for normalisation.

param.name: quantile_norm_target_distrib
param.label: Target distribution to map to during quantile normalisation
param.help: All sample counts get quantile normalised and mapped to a specific distribution so that subsequent can compare them. The pipeline uses scikit-learn's quantile_transform function. You can select the target distribution to map counts to.

param.name: ks_pvalue_threshold
param.label: Threshold for KS p-value for considering samples counts as a uniform distribution
param.help: P-value threshold for the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test of samples counts against a uniform distribution. Samples showing a p-value equal or below this threshold are considered not uniform and will therefore not be considered for computation of the stability score. Examples: `0`, `'0.05'`, `'1E-27'`. Provide a negative value to disable this filter. By default, all samples showing a pvalue of 0 will be discarded.

param.name: min_expr_threshold
param.label: Minimum percentage of quantile expression level
param.help: To avoid genes with low expression levels from being considered for stability scoring, a threshold is set up. For example, a value of 0.2 means that the pipeline will reject genes showing an average expression level in the bottom 20% of all genes.

section.name: stability_scoring_options
section.title: Stability scoring options
section.help: Options relative to assessment of stability for each gene.

param.name: candidate_selection_descriptor
param.label: Statistic descriptor for prior gene candidate selection
param.help: Candidate genes are chosen based on a certain statistical descriptor. Set this parameter to modify the descriptor used.

param.name: stability_score_weights
param.label: Weights for stability score calculation
param.help: Weights for Standard deviation / Median absolute deviation / Normfinder / Genorm respectively. Must be a comma-separated string. Example: 0.7,0.1,0.1,0.1

param.name: nb_top_gene_candidates
param.label: Number of candidate genes to keep for stability scoring
param.help: Number of candidate genes to keep in the final list. These candidates genes are chosen as the ones showing the least standard variation. Default is 1000.
